summary: L-5 cab built 1934 at Coleman Point, Lake County, OR; moved to Fitzwater Point 1948-49 and gone by 1967. No source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Cab moved to Fitzwater Point in 1948 (reassembled 1949) and gone from there by 1967; no source describes the Coleman Point site today

staffing.status: had not been used for a number of years by 1948

events.note: 10 by 10 L-5 lookout cabin built; the site had a crow's nest platform earlier in the 1930s
Cab moved to Fitzwater Point; Oregon Lookouts says it was reassembled there the following year
Fitzwater Point register dates the cab's arrival to 1949
Cab gone from Fitzwater Point by 1967; Coleman Point register says it remained there until 1967

evidence.supports: built 1934 as an L-5 cab, moved to Fitzwater Point in 1948, remained until 1967, crow's nest platform before
evidence.quote: Preceded in the 1930's with a crow's nest platform, this L-5 cab, built in 1934, was moved to Fitzwater Point in 1948, where it remained until 1967.

evidence.supports: Lake County, Oregon; Fremont National Forest
administered by the U.S. Forest Service
listed among former fire lookout sites
lookout house unused for years by 1948, moved to Fitzwater Point and reassembled the following year
evidence.quote: 1948: The lookout house had not been used for a number of years, and was moved to Fitzwater point where it was reassembled the following year.

evidence.supports: Fitzwater Point register: cab moved there in 1949 and gone by 1967
evidence.quote: In 1949, this L-5 cab was moved here from Coleman Point and was gone by 1967.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Coleman Point register and Oregon Lookouts give 1948 for the move; the Fitzwater Point register gives 1949. Oregon Lookouts says it was moved in 1948 and reassembled the following year, which can account for both. Story reports the disagreement.
Coleman Point register says it remained until 1967; Fitzwater Point register says it was gone by 1967. These agree in substance and the story follows both.

notes_for_editor: Brief says access unknown; no access level set because no source covers access. No source describes what remains at Coleman Point or Fitzwater Point today. Fitzwater Point (US 1022, OR 380) is its own record and should link to this one. Oregon Lookouts page also quotes a 1948 Coast and Geodetic Survey station description; not used because it does not describe the site now. Oregon Lookouts cites iamwho.com for the 1936 photos; not checked.
